en: Black‑and‑white view of a grand spa complex with a long colonnaded facade and mansard roof lined with dormer windows. A terrace with café tables sits before broad stairways; mature trees frame the scene and a person stands in the foreground. Printed greeting text appears in the top right. The reverse shows German handwriting, a green 'Postkarte' imprint, a Deutsches Reich stamp canceled in Pyrmont, and a purple museum stamp.
